children.name: Zoom changes the entire interface and reflows the layout to fit your window. The compact default is 85%; the supported range is 50–150%.
Keyboard: Ctrl+− to zoom out · Ctrl++ (or Ctrl+=) to zoom in · Ctrl+0 to reset · Ctrl+, for Settings.
For installation paths, commands and Ubuntu configuration, open Integrations, select a tool's Details, then choose Configure manually.
UI zoom: 95%. Ctrl+− / Ctrl++ to change, Ctrl+0 to reset.
